purpose: Freeze the preregistered, outcome-blind, mechanical blocking-stratum deal over the frozen 128-family WorkflowHub successor frame, execute the bound A3 allocator over the resulting eligible pool, and commit the 96-primary + 32-replication allocation manifest, so that stratification is fixed before any candidate prediction or protected outcome exists while the external curator's semantic adjudication (stratum review and the escrowed REUSE/REOPEN/CANNOT_CHECK gold) remains out of house and pending.

deal_identity.rule_score: SHA256('A3-CHANGE-STRATUM-DEAL-V1|' + workflow_id + '|' + version_before + '|' + version_after + '|' + license_before + '|' + license_after + '|' + before_normalized_sha256 + '|' + after_normalized_sha256)
deal_identity.rule_ordering: ascending by (deal_score_sha256, int(workflow_id), workflow_id) over the 128 frozen families
deal_identity.rule_assignment: STRATA_ORDER[deal_rank mod 4] with STRATA_ORDER = (representation_schema, responsibility_output_contract, objective_acceptance_criterion, evidence_dependency); exactly 32 families per stratum
deal_identity.inputs: frozen 128-family successor frame descriptor-side values only (workflow_id, version_before/after, license_before/after, before/after_normalized_sha256) plus the frozen A6 WorkflowHub census organization lineages (digest-bound)
deal_identity.scope: blocking stratum LABEL only: this deal assigns the stratification dimension required by A3_DETERMINISTIC_PREOUTCOME_ALLOCATION_V1.json before candidate predictions; it makes no REUSE/REOPEN/CANNOT_CHECK judgment, no semantic claim about any family, and no scientific assertion

execution_record.run_environment: ssh billy-old -> billy-laptop-old, Python 3.14.4, 2026-09-03; networkless deterministic compute over committed frozen artifacts (staging ~/orion-a3-alloc-20260903); outputs copied back with sha256 verification

organization_lineage_granularity.rule: normalized_organization_lineage = '{census_org}:family:{workflow_id}' with the census organization lineage verbatim as prefix
organization_lineage_granularity.forcing_arithmetic: the frozen allocator requires GLOBAL uniqueness of normalized_organization_lineage across all 128 selections; the frame holds only 33 distinct census organizations; 33 < 128 distinct values is impossible, so any bare-organization lineage fails the allocator closed (verified mechanically in the validator quota-consequence control); the family-terminated token is the coarsest lineage satisfying the frozen uniqueness contract while preserving the census organization verbatim

custody_note: The curator_assignment_receipt_id on each pool row is the preregistered deal's mechanical receipt, explicitly labeled as standing in for the external curator for the blocking stratum label only; it is not an external custody receipt. The external curator's semantic adjudication (stratum review and the escrowed REUSE/REOPEN/CANNOT_CHECK gold) remains out of house (reviewer scope, SzeChunYiu/ORION-paper#49).

sign_off.nature: external orchestrator merge of this branch on green CI (SzeChunYiu/ORION), never the acting agent
acts: merge of this governance package, the committed evidence and the allocation manifest
subsequent unchecking of the quota boxes in SzeChunYiu/ORION-paper#49 by the orchestrator, not by this lane
